full_judgment: Latifur Rahman J :-  Plaintiff-respondent filed Title suit No. 1483 of 1981 in the Court of Subordinate Judge; Lakshmipur and the same was decreed on 20.4.85. Against the aforesaid judgment and decree the defendants preferred Title Appeal No. 78 of 1985 and the same was dismissed by the Additional District Judge Noakhali on 31.1.87. In revision, a learned single judge of the High Court Division made civil Revision No. 632 of 1987 absolute and set aside the judgment and decree of the lower appellate court and decreed the suit of the plaintiff. The defendant- petitioners are seeking leave to appeal before us from the impugned judgment of the High Court Division.
